title: Judgment has not come yet… but not because God is silent.
paragraphs: Judgment has not come yet… but not because God is silent.
It waits because mercy is still calling.

The world often mocks the idea of God’s judgment.
Many ask, “If God is real, why hasn’t anything happened?”
“The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise… but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.” — 2 Peter 3:9

The delay is not weakness.
It is mercy.

Every sunrise is another invitation.
Every heartbeat is another chance to turn back.
But mercy is also a window, not a permanent door.

The question is not if that day comes…
The question is who will still be ignoring the call when it does.
Are we using the time God has given us wisely?
